name: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC is set up as a joint venture between Aditya Birla Capital Ltd and Sun Life AMC. The Co. offers Mutual Fund services, Portfolio Management services, offshore and real estate offerings. [1]
keyPoints: Key Metrics Q4FY26:[1] Overall QAAUM (including Alternate assets): Rs 4,740 bn Mutual Fund QAAUM: Rs 4,359 bn PMS/AIF QAAUM: Rs 326 bn Offshore Alternate Assets: Rs 48bn[2] Equity Mutual Fund QAAUM: Rs 1,974 bn Passive QAAUM: Rs 411 bn Individual Monthly AAUM: Rs 1,994 bn B-30 Monthly AAUM: Rs 719 bn Monthly SIP book: Rs 12.04 bn Folios served: 11mn Including SIP folios: 4.05 mn
pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 26.4%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 66.6%
